intro: Bahrain is a constitutional monarchy where the king holds most power.

chapters.title: How it works
text: King Hamad bin Isa Al Khalifa appoints the government and the upper house. Voters elect the 40-member Council of Representatives.

chapters.title: Allies
text: The US Navy's Fifth Fleet is based in Bahrain. In 2020 Bahrain agreed to normal relations with Israel.
